title: I've got none. 我没有。
description: Lesson 114 is a picture lesson about 'none', 'no' and 'any' in negative sentences. Twelve pictures (o-z) show pairs of people asking about chocolate, envelopes and cake, with answers using 'I haven't got any', 'I've got no...', 'I've got none', 'Neither have I' and 'So have I'. The written exercises and grammar workbook section focus on rewriting sentences with 'no' and answering questions using the 'any/no/none' pattern.
answer_note: Listening and written exercises A-D are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (dialogues), B (So/Neither), C (situations) are from the workbook answer key (source-key). Grammar I-II are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, p.548-549).

lesson.text: Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

Twelve pictures (o-z) in groups of three: o-q chocolate/envelopes (Have you got any? / I haven't got any. I've got no... I've got none. / I haven't any either. Neither have I.), r-t envelopes (same pattern), u-w cake (Have you got any? / I've got some. / So have I.), x-z cookies (same pattern).
lesson.translation: 十二张图片（o-z）分三组：o-q 巧克力/信封（你有吗？/ 我没有。我没有……我一点也没有。/ 我也没有。我也一点没有。），r-t 信封（同），u-w 蛋糕（你有吗？/ 我有一些。/ 我也有。），x-z 饼干（同）。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the recording and answer the questions for each picture (o-z).
lesson.translation: 听录音并回答每组图片（o-z）的问题。

questions.prompt: Picture o: Have you got any chocolate?
questions.answer: Have you got any chocolate?
I haven't got any. I've got no chocolate. I've got none.
I haven't any either. Neither have I.

questions.prompt: Picture r: Have you got any envelopes?
questions.answer: Have you got any envelopes?
I haven't got any. I've got no envelopes. I've got none.
I haven't any either. Neither have I.

questions.prompt: Picture u: Have you got any cake?
questions.answer: Have you got any cake?
I've got some.
So have I.

questions.prompt: Picture x: Have you got any cookies?
questions.answer: Have you got any cookies?
I've got some.
So have I.

practice.title: Written exercise A
practice.instruction: Rewrite these sentences using 'no'. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 用 no 改写以下句子。（已给出一个例子。）

questions.prompt: There isn't any milk in that bottle.
questions.answer: There is no milk in that bottle.

questions.prompt: There aren't any books on that shelf.
questions.answer: There are no books on that shelf.
I've got no money.

questions.prompt: I didn't see any cars in the street.
questions.answer: I saw no cars in the street.

practice.title: Written exercise B
practice.instruction: Answer these questions. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。（已给出一个例子。）

questions.answer: No, I haven't got any beer. I've got no beer. I've got none.
No, I haven't got any milk. I've got no milk. I've got none.
No, I haven't got any envelopes. I've got no envelopes. I've got none.
No, I haven't got any magazines. I've got no magazines. I've got none.

practice.title: Written exercise C
practice.instruction: Write new sentences. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 模仿例句完成以下句子。（已给出一个例子。）

questions.answer: Neither am I. I'm not tired, either.
Neither am I. I'm not hungry, either.
Neither did I. I didn't meet him, either.
Neither was I. I wasn't at church yesterday, either.
Neither do I. I don't like ice cream, either.
Neither can I. I can't swim, either.

practice.title: Written exercise D
practice.instruction: Write new sentences. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 模仿例句完成以下句子。（已给出一个例子。）

questions.answer: So am I. I'm tired, too.
So am I. I'm hungry, too.
So did I. I met him, too.
So was I. I was at church yesterday, too.
So do I. I like ice cream, too.
So can I. I can swim, too.

practice.title: Practice A: Complete the dialogues
practice.instruction: Complete the dialogues using 'any', 'no' and 'none'. 用 any、no 和 none 完成以下对话。
practice.translation: 用 any、no 和 none 完成以下对话。
practice.context: Workbook L114 A: 4 dialogues with any/no/none.

questions.prompt: A: Was there any chocolate left? B: No, there was no chocolate left. There was none at all.
questions.answer: No, there was no chocolate left. There was none at all.

questions.prompt: A: Were there any envelopes in the desk? B: ...
questions.answer: No, there weren't any envelopes. There were no envelopes. There were none.

questions.prompt: A: Have you got any milk? B: ...
questions.answer: No, I haven't got any milk. I've got no milk. I've got none.

questions.prompt: A: Are there any people on that bus? B: ...
questions.answer: No, there aren't any people. There are no people. There are none.

practice.title: Practice B: Agree using So... or Neither...
practice.instruction: Agree with these statements using So... or Neither... 用 So... 或 Neither... 对以下陈述表示赞同。
practice.translation: 用 So... 或 Neither... 对以下陈述表示赞同。
practice.context: Workbook L114 B: items 1-12 (item 1 is the printed example).

questions.answer: So am I.
Neither am I.
So have I.
Neither have I.
So was I.
Neither was I.
So did I.
Neither did I.
So can I.
Neither can I.
So do I.
Neither do I.

practice.title: Practice C: Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What do you say in each? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.translation: 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。

questions.prompt: You and a friend want to buy a newspaper. It doesn't cost much, but you only have a five-pound note. How do you ask the friend for small change?
questions.answer: Have you got any small change? I've got no small change. I've got none.

questions.prompt: Someone says to you: 'I don't like coffee much.' How do you agree?
questions.answer: Neither do I. I don't like coffee much, either.

questions.prompt: You want to buy a newspaper. It doesn't cost much, but you only have a five-pound note. How do you ask the friend for small change?
questions.answer: Have you got any small change?
